id: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again (2018)
title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
tagline: New hotel, old flames, plenty of feta.
about: As Sophie gets her mother's island hotel ready for a grand reopening, the story of how young Donna first came to Kalokairi plays out alongside.
cue: Serve the keftedes when young Donna steps off the boat onto Kalokairi for the first time.
faces: Rooms are made up, the storm took half the bunting and the boat with the guests is running late. Keep the moussaka warm and the terrace lights on.
New hotel, old flames, plenty of feta.
Ham, gruyere and dijon in fried buttered bread, topped with nutmeg cheese sauce and grilled.
Fried fritters of ripe tomato, red onion, mint, oregano and feta, with garlic tzatziki and lemon.
Lit on the terrace before the storm rolls in.
Roasted eggplant layered with lamb mince in cinnamon and tomato.
Grilled on the terrace, the summer of 1979.
Greek orange and yoghurt cake made with torn dried filo, soaked in hot orange and cinnamon syrup.
Chilled dry sparkling wine over peach nectar with a squeeze of lemon and a thin slice of fresh peach.
Fernando's pour for Ruby, after all these years.
A tray charge applies to every order. Prices subject to change. A sailor named Bill and his little boat. A night in Paris with a nervous Englishman. Form RS 1979. Images: TMDB.
